name: Flame Proof Cage Hoist
description: Safe Build Engineering's Flame Proof Cage Hoist is fabricated using premium quality raw materials for hazardous industrial environments. Designed for transferring heavy bulk material in explosive atmospheres, it features robust flameproof construction, dual disc braking and heavy duty wire rope guidance for safe reliable operation.
features: Heavy duty wire rope guide for safe rope guidance
Robust flameproof design for long trouble free functioning
Quick and easy installation with minimal maintenance
Equipped with dual disc asbestos free DC brake
Two upper and lower position geared limit switches
